original_question: Determine whether the free group factors L(F_n) are elementarily equivalent for different values of n.
target_in_paper: Problem 35 ("II_1 factor Tarski’s problem") in the section "Miscellaneous." ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
correct_elements: Your draft already identifies the exact family of objects and the exact relation asked about in the paper: the free group factors L(F_n), compared across different ranks n, with the question phrased in terms of elementary equivalence rather than isomorphism. That is essentially the official Problem 35. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
missing_details: The ambient setting should be stated explicitly: this is the II_1-factor / tracial von Neumann algebra version of the Tarski problem, not the group-theoretic or reduced C*-algebraic version. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))

The quantifier should be made explicit: the intended question is whether L(F_n) and L(F_m) are elementarily equivalent for distinct ranks n and m, not whether there merely exists some pair with that property. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))

The paper’s meaning of "elementarily equivalent" should be spelled out: II_1 factors M and N are called elementarily equivalent if there exist ultrafilters U and V such that M^U is isomorphic to N^V. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))

To make the question stand alone while remaining in the II_1-factor setting, one should restrict to the nonabelian free groups, so the ranks should be written as distinct integers n,m ≥ 2. This rank restriction is an inference from the fact that Problem 35 is explicitly the II_1-factor version. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))

No extra hypotheses such as Connes embeddability, McDuffness, property Gamma, or existential closedness belong in this question; Problem 35 is asked just for the family L(F_n). ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))

The question should not be broadened to the reduced group C*-algebra analogue, since the paper separately notes that version has already been resolved negatively. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
refined_question: For distinct integers n,m ≥ 2, where F_n denotes the free group on n generators, are the free group factors L(F_n) and L(F_m) elementarily equivalent as tracial II_1 factors; that is, do there exist nonprincipal ultrafilters U and V on N such that L(F_n)^U ≅ L(F_m)^V? ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
justification: The draft is already very close to the paper’s exact target: it matches Problem 35, the paper’s "II_1 factor Tarski’s problem." The only hidden assumptions that need to be made explicit for a stand-alone version are the II_1-factor setting, the universal quantification over distinct ranks, and the paper’s ultrapower-based meaning of elementary equivalence. I therefore sharpened the draft only by making those implicit conventions explicit and by keeping it separate from the neighboring reduced C*-algebraic problem that the paper says is already settled negatively. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
